name: Wang Feng-yüan
bio: Wang Feng-yüan is dated by Giles to the 12th century AD. His poem here is a poem of the third month, when spring is past.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: The Third Moon
poems.author: Wang Feng-yüan
poems.text:
In May flowers fade, and others come to bloom among the leaves,
While all day long the nesting swallow flits around the eaves.
The night-jar cries half through the night until the blood flows fast.
Ah vainly hoping to recall the spring that now is past!
